title: Polynomial-time computability of the loop
statement: The function on bit strings obtained by iterating the defined loop step is computable in polynomial time: there exist a finite-state Turing machine and natural numbers $C,c$ such that, on every input $x$, the machine halts after exactly $C(|x|+1)^c$ steps and outputs the result of applying the loop to $x$.
hypotheses_covered: There exist a finite-state Turing machine and natural numbers $C,c$
The claim applies to every input bit string
The running time is exactly $C(|x|+1)^c$ steps
